subject: Mathematics
name: Basic 6 Mathematics
description: The Basic 6 Mathematics curriculum consolidates skills in number sense, algebra, geometry, and data handling. It introduces numbers up to 1,000,000,000, operations with larger numbers, advanced fraction concepts including ratios and proportions, algebraic expressions and equations, 3D shapes like prisms, geometric transformations, and advanced data interpretation including probability.
